en: The postcard features an old, grand building with ornate architectural elements characteristic of a castle or palace. The structure has multiple steeply pitched roofs, turrets, and decorative detailing. The image appears to be monochrome or tinted, possibly an early 20th-century print. At the top of the postcard, there is red text in a Slavic language using the Latin alphabet, reading 'Dvorac grofa Mailatha' and 'D. MIHOLJAC.' The foreground features a pathway leading to the entrance and some bushes or trees.
